title: CommitteeParams
description: FOMC committee vote parameters. SPEC-COMM-2: dissent tolerance and lean weights.

dissent_tolerance.description: Absolute rate difference between a member's preferred rate (state-only) and the Chair's proposed rate above which the member dissents.

neutral_rate.description: The nominal policy rate the committee would set at target inflation and natural unemployment (the anchor for every member's preferred-rate computation).

hawkish_inflation_weight.description: Factor by which hawkish members scale the inflation gap when computing preferred rate.

dovish_unemployment_weight.description: Factor by which dovish members scale the unemployment gap when computing preferred rate.

neutral_blend.description: Weight of the inflation gap in the neutral member blend (0..1); unemployment weight is 1 - neutral_blend.

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target used by all member types when computing gap_inflation.

target_unemployment.description: Natural rate of unemployment used by all member types when computing gap_unemployment.
